name: Bachelor's degree attainment, age 25+

anchors.source: U.S. adult bachelor's attainment was ~20% in the late 1980s and reached ~37–38% by 2024. L=20 anchors on the domestic historical low of the modern series; U=45 anchors above current U.S. levels at a plausible OECD-leader ceiling (e.g., Canada, Korea, Ireland for tertiary attainment adjusted for definitional differences).
